_readme: Known-red baseline for scripts/prepush_test_gate.py.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: on 2026-07-26 a red deterministic gate shipped anyway,
waved through as 'pre-existing failures untouched'. 'Pre-existing' was an
unbounded, unowned, unrecorded free pass. This file makes it bounded, owned,
recorded, and expiring.
CONTRACT:
- A test that fails and is NOT listed here BLOCKS the push. No exceptions.
- A test listed here and not yet expired WARNS, naming owner + days left.
- ANY entry past its 'expires' date BLOCKS every push until it is removed
or explicitly re-dated with a fresh reason. An expiry you can ignore is
not an expiry.
- A listed test that now PASSES is reported as a stale suppression; delete
the entry.
- A missing, malformed, or schema-violating file BLOCKS. A suppression list
you cannot read is not a suppression list.
EVERY entry REQUIRES all four fields: test, reason, owner, expires.
'test' is a pytest node id (path::Class::test) or, for coarse short-lived
suppression, a bare test-file path. File-scoped entries suppress the whole
file — use them only when the specific id is unstable, and keep the expiry
days away, not weeks.
'expires' is YYYY-MM-DD (UTC date). Past that date the gate blocks.

entries.reason: Red BY DESIGN and correctly so — do not skip it. MLX_DEFAULT_MODEL is mxbai-embed-large-v1 while OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL is bge-m3. Both emit 1024 dims so every shape check passes, but measured cosine on identical text is -0.0487: they are orthogonal embedding spaces. This assertion is the only thing surfacing that a backend fallback moves a caller between embedding spaces mid-run. Blocked on a user decision, not on engineering work: BUIL-MEMORY-m0hcg9vzf60y895rj3vt9 picks which model MLX uses.
